agent_policy_amount.name: agent_policy_amount
agent_policy_amount.value: policy_max_stroops = trunc(policy_max_stroops) AND policy_max_stroops >= 0 AND policy_max_stroops <= 170141183460469231731687303715884105727

agent_nonce.name: agent_nonce
agent_nonce.value: last_nonce = trunc(last_nonce) AND last_nonce >= 0 AND last_nonce <= 18446744073709551615

agent_active_policy.name: agent_active_policy
agent_active_policy.value: status <> 'active' OR (policy_max_stroops > 0 AND policy_observed_ledger IS NOT NULL)

run_budget.name: run_budget
run_budget.value: budget_stroops = trunc(budget_stroops) AND budget_stroops > 0 AND budget_stroops <= 170141183460469231731687303715884105727

run_reserved.name: run_reserved
run_reserved.value: reserved_stroops = trunc(reserved_stroops) AND reserved_stroops >= 0 AND reserved_stroops <= 170141183460469231731687303715884105727

run_spent.name: run_spent
run_spent.value: spent_stroops = trunc(spent_stroops) AND spent_stroops >= 0 AND spent_stroops <= 170141183460469231731687303715884105727

run_bounds.name: run_bounds
run_bounds.value: model_turns BETWEEN 0 AND 8 AND tool_steps BETWEEN 0 AND 12 AND length(task_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

job_lease.name: job_lease
job_lease.value: (status = 'leased' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'leased' AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL)

claim_amount.name: claim_amount
claim_amount.value: observed_claim_amount_stroops = trunc(observed_claim_amount_stroops) AND observed_claim_amount_stroops >= 0 AND observed_claim_amount_stroops <= 170141183460469231731687303715884105727

claim_confirmation.name: claim_confirmation
claim_confirmation.value: status <> 'confirmed' OR (tx_hash IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND observed_claim_amount_stroops IS NOT NULL)

attempt_nonce.name: attempt_nonce
attempt_nonce.value: nonce = trunc(nonce) AND nonce > 0 AND nonce <= 18446744073709551615

attempt_cipher.name: attempt_cipher
attempt_cipher.value: (signed_xdr_ciphertext IS NULL AND cipher_iv IS NULL AND cipher_tag IS NULL AND encryption_key_version IS NULL) OR (signed_xdr_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND cipher_iv IS NOT NULL AND cipher_tag IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(cipher_iv) = 12 AND octet_length(cipher_tag) = 16 AND encryption_key_version IS NOT NULL AND signed_xdr_fingerprint IS NOT NULL)

attempt_handoff.name: attempt_handoff
attempt_handoff.value: handoff_committed_at IS NULL OR (velo_request_id IS NOT NULL AND inner_hash IS NOT NULL AND signed_xdr_ciphertext IS NULL)

evidence_amount.name: evidence_amount
evidence_amount.value: amount_stroops = trunc(amount_stroops) AND amount_stroops > 0 AND amount_stroops <= 170141183460469231731687303715884105727

evidence_fee.name: evidence_fee
evidence_fee.value: actual_fee_stroops = trunc(actual_fee_stroops) AND actual_fee_stroops >= 0 AND actual_fee_stroops <= 170141183460469231731687303715884105727

evidence_nonce.name: evidence_nonce
evidence_nonce.value: nonce = trunc(nonce) AND nonce > 0 AND nonce <= 18446744073709551615

evidence_hash_mapping.name: evidence_hash_mapping
evidence_hash_mapping.value: observed_event_tx_hash = inner_hash OR (outer_hash IS NOT NULL AND observed_event_tx_hash = outer_hash)

evidence_fee_source.name: evidence_fee_source
evidence_fee_source.value: (actual_fee_stroops IS NULL AND fee_provenance = 'unavailable') OR (actual_fee_stroops IS NOT NULL AND fee_provenance IN ('outer_ledger','outer_ledger_and_velo'))

quote_amount.name: quote_amount
quote_amount.value: amount_stroops = trunc(amount_stroops) AND amount_stroops > 0 AND amount_stroops <= 170141183460469231731687303715884105727

quote_lifetime.name: quote_lifetime
quote_lifetime.value: expires_at > created_at AND expires_at <= created_at + interval '120 seconds'

quote_acceptance.name: quote_acceptance
quote_acceptance.value: (status IN ('open','expired','refused') OR accepted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (accepted_at IS NULL OR accepted_at < expires_at)

resource_price.name: resource_price
resource_price.value: price_stroops = trunc(price_stroops) AND price_stroops > 0 AND price_stroops <= 170141183460469231731687303715884105727

session_scope.name: session_scope
session_scope.value: (role = 'owner' AND owner_id IS NOT NULL AND merchant_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL) OR (role = 'merchant' AND merchant_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL) OR (role = 'worker' AND owner_id IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND merchant_id IS NULL)

session_lifetime.name: session_lifetime
session_lifetime.value: expires_at > created_at AND expires_at <= created_at + CASE WHEN role = 'worker' THEN interval '15 minutes' ELSE interval '8 hours' END

wallet_role_kind.name: wallet_role_kind
wallet_role_kind.value: (role = 'merchant' AND operation_kind = 'claim' AND agent_id IS NULL) OR (role = 'owner' AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND operation_kind IN ('registerDevice','registerAgent','fundEscrow','defundEscrow','revokeAgent','sweepOnRevoke'))

wallet_handoff.name: wallet_handoff
wallet_handoff.value: handoff_committed_at IS NULL OR tx_hash IS NOT NULL
